subject: PO formatting, acceptance codes, pricing bands and invoice cadence
messages:
From: Thomas Li <t.li@acmehealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurements@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements and pricing questions for Redwood pilot

Hi Priya,

Thanks again — procurement at Acme is working through the PO and billing side for the pilot (deal D-3489). A couple of items to confirm before we route internally:

- PO metadata: our ERP requires an acceptance code and a PO line-level commodity code; can Redwood provide a recommended PO field mapping we can include so invoices auto-match?
- Invoice cadence: finance prefers a monthly consolidated invoice versus weekly micro-invoices. We can provide a blanket PO referencing monthly invoices, but need to confirm Redwood can accept multiple invoice lines under one PO number.
- Pricing bands: we received internal guidance that discounts kick in at $75k ARR commitment buckets. Can you confirm if Redwood can materially align discount bands to our purchasing slabs? Any minimum invoice or minimum lot requirements?
- Net terms: our standard is Net 60. Does Redwood have flexibility on Net 60 for committed enterprise customers, or are you primarily Net 30/45?

If it helps, I can share the ERP acceptance-code examples (we use the AR_ACE and ACPT codes). We need something we can hand to our AP team so the vendor hookup is smooth.

Thanks,
Thomas
Procurement Manager
Acme Health Systems

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Thomas Li <t.li@acmehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements and pricing questions for Redwood pilot

Thomas —

Appreciate the detail. Quick summary and next steps below; attaching our PO guide and the pricing band worksheet so you can circulate to AP and sourcing.

Answers / proposals:
1) PO field mapping: we can accept a PO number that covers multiple invoices and will include line-level metadata if you populate the PO line with SKU and "Redwood Service" as the commodity. Attached is a one-page mapping that shows the ERP field, our Invoice field, and sample values (we'll include the acceptance code on the invoice header if you provide the specific code string).

2) Invoice cadence: we support consolidated monthly invoices under a single PO. Our billing system can collapse weekly usage into monthly statements with line-item token usage and plan fees. If you need a single monthly PDF per entity, we can do that — just confirm the PO will be valid for the month-end cutoff (see point 4).

3) Pricing bands & minimums: standard commercial bands in the worksheet: 0-49k, 50-149k, 150k+. For enterprise commitments we can offer an alternate slab where pricing bands shift at 75k and 200k (we've indicated proposed margins in the attached workbook). Minimum invoice amount: no strict minimum, but we recommend monthly consolidation to avoid per-invoice processing friction.

4) Cutoff for monthly invoices / acceptance window: our standard invoice cut-off is UTC 23:59 on the last day of the invoice period. To ensure auto-match in your ERP, confirm your acceptance-code needs and the timezone your AP system expects for the matching cut-off.

Next steps: Ben (cc'd) will confirm discount approval paths for the 75k slab; Marissa will coordinate contract language for Net 60. If you can share the exact acceptance-code token and your ERP commodity code, we'll populate sample invoices for your AP to test.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_PO_Guide_v2.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: Acme_MA_Platform_Pricing_Table.xlsx (XLSX)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, Thomas Li <t.li@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements and pricing questions for Redwood pilot

Thomas / Priya —

Quick note from the commercial side: we can align a special 75k slab for Acme (deal D-3489) but need two things to lock margin and Net 60:

- Contractual commitment: a 12-month minimum consumption commitment at the 75k ARR threshold (we can model a true-up each quarter).
- Billing cadence: monthly consolidated invoices only (this reduces AP overhead and lets us handle the discounting at invoice run).

If you accept those, I can approve a 7.5% discount across the 75k slab and a 12% discount at the 200k+ slab (these are special one-off rates for the pilot-to-production path). We'll require a PO that includes a billing entity identifier (EIN or internal billing code) and the ERP acceptance-code on the invoice header for auto-posting.

Regarding Net 60: Marissa, are we able to support Net 60 as an enterprise exception for Acme if legal accepts a short-credit assessment?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Thomas Li <t.li@acmehealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurements@acmehealth.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements and pricing questions for Redwood pilot

Priya / Ben —

Thanks — that all looks workable. A few closing asks before we send the PO to AP:

- Please populate a sample invoice for May (using the AR_ACE acceptance code and our commodity code CH-5011) so our AP team can validate auto-match.
- We'll confirm the 12-month commitment internally, but the commercial language that ties discounted slabs to the commitment is acceptable in principle.
- Net 60: we'll proceed with the procurement approval under Net 60 but will need the brief credit-assessment questionnaire from Redwood to complete the supplier onboarding. Can you send that and a contact for your billing team?

If you can get the sample invoice and the credit questionnaire over early next week, we'll target PO issuance by 05/28 and the first monthly invoice for June.

Appreciate the responsiveness — looking forward to getting this live.

Regards,
Thomas Li
Procurement Manager, Acme Health Systems
